headline: 16.5 million euros for jobs in Gorj and Dolj
summary: Employers in Gorj and Dolj can receive subsidies for hiring graduates and unemployed persons. Almost 16.5 million euros is available, with 9.3 million for Gorj and 7.2 million for Dolj.
why: EU-funded hiring subsidies under the Just Transition framework support local labour markets in Romanian coal-dependent regions.
